title: Sparkly hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd54a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8c1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8f0ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ac8e8' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wood' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c97b3a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a4f22'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- top and bottom caps -->
  <rect x='28' y='10' width='44' height='8' rx='3' fill='url(#wood)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='44' height='8' rx='3' fill='url(#wood)'/>

  <!-- cap highlights -->
  <rect x='30' y='11' width='40' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#e8a96b'/>
  <rect x='30' y='83' width='40' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#e8a96b'/>

  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M33 18 L33 40 C33 47 45 50 45 50 C45 50 33 53 33 60 L33 82 L67 82 L67 60 C67 53 55 50 55 50 C55 50 67 47 67 40 L67 18 Z'
        fill='url(#glass)' stroke='#9fe6f5' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- top sand -->
  <path d='M36 20 L64 20 L64 38 C64 44 54 48 50 50 C46 48 36 44 36 38 Z' fill='url(#sand)'/>

  <!-- bottom sand pile -->
  <path d='M36 80 L64 80 L64 66 C64 60 54 56 50 54 C46 56 36 60 36 66 Z' fill='url(#sand)'/>

  <!-- falling sand stream -->
  <rect x='49' y='46' width='2.5' height='10' rx='1' fill='#ffc233'/>

  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M37 22 L37 36 C37 41 42 44 44 46' stroke='#d6f7ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M37 64 L37 78' stroke='#d6f7ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff4a8'>
    <!-- sparkle 1 top left -->
    <path d='M18 24 L19.5 28 L23.5 29.5 L19.5 31 L18 35 L16.5 31 L12.5 29.5 L16.5 28 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 2 top right -->
    <path d='M82 16 L83.5 20 L87.5 21.5 L83.5 23 L82 27 L80.5 23 L76.5 21.5 L80.5 20 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 3 mid right -->
    <path d='M85 50 L86 53 L89 54 L86 55 L85 58 L84 55 L81 54 L84 53 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 4 bottom left -->
    <path d='M15 70 L16.5 74 L20.5 75.5 L16.5 77 L15 81 L13.5 77 L9.5 75.5 L13.5 74 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle 5 bottom right -->
    <path d='M80 78 L81.5 82 L85.5 83.5 L81.5 85 L80 89 L78.5 85 L74.5 83.5 L78.5 82 Z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='36' r='1.7' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='58' r='1.6' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='66' r='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='1.8' fill='#ffe680'/>
</svg>
